about: What the picture finder was measured to do for each kind of object, and the highest answer level that evidence supports today. Read by src/services/answer_levels.py; rules in docs/rules/ANSWER_LEVELS_RULES.md. Every number here was measured on 2026-10-11 with YOLOE-11s visual prompts (3 marks on the same picture unless a protocol says otherwise), scored as AP50 against people's boxes, on 20 pictures unless n_images says otherwise. The scripts that produced them are in the measuring session's scratchpad (contest/src) and are NOT in this repository, so these numbers cannot be re-run from the repo yet.

measured.dataset: every target below that has a value
measured.protocol: YOLOE-11s visual prompts, 3 marks on the same picture; object size in pixels compared with the score per target
measured.where: measuring session scratchpad, contest/src (scripts not in this repository)
measured.note: Below about 25-30 px across, every target failed; at about 50 px and more, targets did well. 50 px is that measured floor, not a fitted cut-off.
